review_evidence: README identifies the project as Lean bindings to the C and Rust BLAKE3 implementations and documents HasherOps as the common executable API.
A complete scan of five Lean source files found 52 declaration-style items but only one proposition declaration, ByteArray.size_of_extract, a small byte-array size helper.

The substantive modules expose FFI hashers, version/finalization wrappers, keyed-hash/derive-key calls and a sponge wrapper; they do not state or prove the BLAKE3 compression/hash specification, conformance, collision/security properties, or correctness of the foreign implementations.

source_action.content_invariant: The source is a C/Rust BLAKE3 binding and executable API wrapper. Its sole theorem is an incidental ByteArray extraction-size fact; there is no independent formal BLAKE3 specification or correctness/security development, so retirement does not remove the mathematical/semantics prior art sought by the corpus.
